author: Saberin C
description:
Soraya Bouazzaoui’s debut Aicha reclaims and rewrites the fable of the same name, a mythological succubus in Moroccan lore. Set against the backdrop of Portuguese-occupied Morocco, we follow the origin story of Aicha, and her family of freedom fighters. A creature simmers in Aicha’s soul, since before she can even remember, and it is angry. […]
